name: @gjsify/gtk-runtime-darwin-arm64
description: Batteries-included, relocated GTK/GObject-Introspection runtime bundle for macOS arm64 — lets @gjsify/node-gi load gi:// namespaces (GLib/GObject/Gio/cairo/Pango/Graphene/Gdk) with NO Homebrew GTK. Platform-gated (darwin/arm64 only).

gaps.why: `isomp4` demuxes the container and hands the decoder raw AAC directly, after which nothing decodes it. The two elements that would are `faad` (gst-plugins-bad, GPL) and `avdec_aac` (libav, whose whole closure these bundles refuse), so shipping one is a redistribution decision for whoever ships the product rather than this bundle's. win32 claims this format instead, through `mfaacdec` — the OS's own decoder, wrapped by the same `mediafoundation` plugin that closed MP3 there (ADR 0056 § 7); that route does not exist here, because there is no Media Foundation on macOS.

`audioparsers` supplies `aacparse` for a raw ADTS stream, after which nothing decodes it — the same `faad`/`avdec_aac` exclusion as the `AAC (M4A)` gap. win32 does not claim this shape either, even though it has `mediafoundation`: measured on CI, `mfaacdec` decodes the M4A shape but stalls (no sample, no EOS) on a bare ADTS stream through `decodebin3` (ADR 0056 § 7). So this format is a gap on every target today.
